# Code of Conduct

## Our Standards

Aurora MarvinS is an open-source project intended to be a welcoming place for people interested in Aurora 4X and the project itself.

When participating in the project, please:

- Be respectful and constructive.
- Assume good intentions.
- Focus on the issue or contribution rather than the person.
- Accept constructive criticism.
- Avoid harassment, personal attacks and discriminatory behavior.
- Keep discussions relevant to the project.

## Unacceptable Behavior

The following behavior is not acceptable:

- Harassment or personal attacks.
- Discriminatory or hateful comments.
- Threats or intimidation.
- Deliberate disruption of project discussions.
- Sharing private information about others without permission.

## Project Maintainer

The project maintainer may remove or close comments, Issues or Pull Requests that violate these guidelines.

Repeated or serious violations may result in restrictions on participation in the project.

## Reporting Problems

If you experience or witness behavior that violates this Code of Conduct, please contact the project maintainer privately through GitHub.

Thank you for helping keep Aurora MarvinS a constructive and welcoming project.
